questionEn: Which formulation more accurately distinguishes “a family of chemical elements” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formulada "kimyoviy elementlar oilasi" o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq farqlanadi?
choicesEn: A family of chemical elements is a group of chemical elements with similar properties.
Vertical column of elements with similar properties
Increasing atomic number and periodic repetition of properties
choicesUz: Kimyoviy elementlar oilasi - o'xshash xususiyatlarga ega kimyoviy elementlar guruhi.
Xuddi shunday xususiyatlarga ega bo'lgan elementlarning vertikal ustuni
Atom sonini oshirish va xususiyatlarning davriy takrorlanishi
explanationEn: A family of chemical elements is a group of chemical elements with similar properties.
explanationUz: Kimyoviy elementlar oilasi - o'xshash xususiyatlarga ega kimyoviy elementlar guruhi.
